newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria offers 15,000 tonnes of barley for export.
newsitem.headline: Syria offers 15,000 tonnes of barley for export.

text.p: Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade (GECPT) has offered 15,000 tonnes of white feed barley for export, an official spokesman said.
He told Reuters an international call for bids had already been issued and that November 11 was the final date for offers. Results would be made available on November 12.
He said the barley would be ready for shipment in December.
